text:
maria: quick standup — GPU fleet check

maria: Yesterday: rotated 2 preemptible nodes in us-west1, validated quantization profiles on canary model, and ran a short throughput sweep. Blocker: spot eviction spikes ~10% over last 24h in us-west1 causing transient tail latency. Today: planning to raise autoscaler softlimit and open a quota request with cloud. Need someone to triage failovers if eviction >15%.

aj: noted. I'll dig into the spot-eviction dashboards and run a small canary sim. Can you paste the exact prometheus query you used? Also pinging @lee for the quota ask.

maria: query I used: `sum(rate(spot_evictions[1h])) by (az)` — alert last fired at 02:12 UTC. Quick log snippet: ```evict: node-aks-42 got TERMINATE at 02:10, running 120 pods``` — looks like batch jobs are the common victims.

lee: I'm on quota. If we need extra on-demand capacity we'll need a formal request to cloud with vGPU counts and region. I can draft the ticket, will need expected numbers.

maria: probable ask: +8 vGPUs in us-west1 (prod pool) +4 reserve for canaries. Can we also throttle lower-priority batch jobs as a short-term mitigation? @sophie can you help?

sophie: yes, we can throttle batch. Plan: add a temporary preemption class and patch cronjobs to lower resource requests. Command I'll run: `kubectl patch cronjob batch-heavy -p '{"spec": {"suspend": true}}'` for the heaviest ones, then reintroduce. Scheduling that for 10:30am PT. Also thinking fallback shapes to `g5.xlarge` for short runs.

aj: test plan — run stress across 3 canaries: `stress-ng --gpu 1 --timeout 300s` and monitor queue latency + eviction rate. I'll start at 09:45 PT and post numbers here. I'm also prepping a tiny PR to make the autoscaler respect `spot_pct` override.

deploy-bot: maria requested autoscaler softlimit bump — Ticket created: #INF-3421 https://tickets.example/INF-3421 (assigned to lee).

lee: bumped ticket to P1 and added cloud-accounts team. cc @ops-lead for approval window.

maria: thanks. Also FYI folks — please review my PR #5123 (autoscaler config) when you get a chance, it's a small backoff tweak.

sophie: I can review after 11am PT. If anything blocks throttle rollout I'll DM.

aj: taking ownership of the canary run and will post results.

maria: cheers :thumbsup:

aj: canary run complete — eviction rate dropped from ~10% -> 3% after throttling batch jobs; tail latency improved from 320ms -> 160ms. No new evictions for the last 30m. Logs: `CANARY_OK`

maria: awesome, great work. Next steps: lee files the quota request, keep throttles for 2h after quota is approved, and merge PR #5123 once reviews are in.

sophie: noted, I'll keep the enforcement window and prepare rollback steps.

aj: leaving follow-ups in INF-3421 and will add the raw graphs attachment.
